#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long n, long long mod) {
    long long ret = 1;
    while (n > 0) {
        if (n & 1) ret = ret * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return ret;
}

long long modinv(long long a, long long mod) {
    long long b = mod, p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        long long c = a / b;
        long long d = a; a = b; b = d % b;
        d = p; p = q; q = d - c * q;
    }
    return (p < 0 ? p + mod : p);
}

long long C(int n, int r, const vector<long long>& f, const vector<long long>& invf) {
    if (n < 0 || r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return f[n] * invf[r] % MOD * invf[n - r] % MOD;
}

pair<vector<long long>, vector<long long>> enumFIF(int n, int mod) {
    vector<long long> f(n + 1), invf(n + 1);
    f[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % mod;
    invf[n] = modinv(f[n], mod);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) invf[i] = invf[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
    return {f, invf};
}

void solve() {
    int n;
    long long K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    if (K >= n) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return;
    }
    auto fif = enumFIF(250000, MOD);
    if (K == 0) {
        cout << fif.first[n] << '\n';
        return;
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    long long s = 1;
    for (int i = (int)(n - K); i >= 1; i--) {
        ans = (ans + C(n, i, fif.first, fif.second) * pow_mod(i, n, MOD) % MOD * s % MOD * C((int)(n - i), (int)K, fif.first, fif.second)) % MOD;
        s = (MOD - s) % MOD;
    }
    ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
    cout << ans << '\n';
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
